title: config.routing_pin: a supervisor's pin or exclusions for one agent (0.11.0)
description: One document per (tenant, agent) on the compacted topic config.routing_pin, key {tenant_id}/{agent_id}; a Kafka tombstone unpins. Pins ignore dwell (a person decided), apply at the agent's next offer (never mid-call) and never leave a queue without a logged-in eligible agent (such a pin waits). A pin naming an agent or queue of another tenant, or a key naming another tenant, is refused and counted. Approvals of advise-mode recommendations become pins with until_ms.

queues.description: The agent's active set while pinned (any number of queues and tiers); only queues it is a member of and eligible for count

exclusions.description: Queues the agent never takes calls from (escalated calls included)

until_ms.description: The pin ends then (epoch ms); 0 or absent: until a tombstone
